enchantments.tooltip: Faeryfire Curse: Empowered by the Fearylights, your Illusion spells have a chance to curse your enemies with Purple Faery Fire, dispelling stealth, invisibility, blur, and displacement for 30 seconds, and giving a -40 penalty to hide. Sightless enemies are immune to the dazzle effect.
Illusory Death 3: Increases your caster level when casting illusion and necromancy spells by 3.
Quality Wizardry +67: +67 Quality bonus to spell points.
Magical Efficiency 10%: You take a 10% Enhancement discount to the Spell Point cost of your spells.
Mythic Head Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
